name: BR 286 Bpmmbdzf
description: Intercity Cab Car (German:IC Steuerwagen) (Bpmmbdzf) is a German IC cab car. The version Bpmmbdzf 296 is included in Expert DB BR 101 & IC Steuerwagen (in white long-distance livery). The services for the long-distance version can additionally be expanded with the Expert DB BR 101 on Kassel - Würzburg Gameplay Pack. The red-colored München-Nürnberg-Express variant Bpmmbdzf 286.3 comes with Schnellfahrstrecke Nürnberg - Ingolstadt.
